name: dipoleml-moodle-dev
description: The most complete Moodle development toolkit: 13 skills, 8 slash commands, 2 subagents — covering scaffolding, XMLDB, capabilities, web services, Hooks API, AMD JS, PHPUnit, Behat, security, privacy/GDPR, performance, accessibility, themes, mobile, and cross-version upgrades. Ships with adapters for Cursor, Copilot, Aider, Continue, plus a companion MCP server (moodle-mcp) for live moodledev.io documentation lookups.
